fact: The party arrives in Gracklstugh after traveling across the Darklake.
source_quote: the party finally tied up their boat at the grim duergar city of Gracklstugh
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: Gracklstugh emits an acrid heat and the light of countless forges reflects off the dark water.
source_quote: A wave of acrid heat slammed against their faces as the light of countless forges reflected off the dark water
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: The streets of Gracklstugh are crowded with drow, svirfneblin, derro, orcs, and other races.
source_quote: Drow, svirfneblin, derro, orcs and other races moved through the crowds
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: Hemeth is a duergar arms dealer whom the party rescued.
source_quote: Hemeth, the duergar arms dealer they had rescued
subject: Hemeth

fact: Hemeth warns the party that non-duergar are permitted only in the Darklake district.
source_quote: Hemeth, the duergar arms dealer they had rescued, warned them that non-duergar were permitted only in the Darklake district
subject: Hemeth's warning

fact: Hemeth warns the party that the city's laws are swift and merciless.
source_quote: warned them that non-duergar were permitted only in the Darklake district, and that the city's laws were swift and merciless
subject: Hemeth's warning

fact: Duergar guards can turn invisible at will.
source_quote: Guards who could turn invisible at will
subject: Duergar Guards

fact: Theft in Gracklstugh is punishable by death on the spot with no trial.
source_quote: enforced a code where theft was punishable by death on the spot, no trial required
subject: Duergar Guards

fact: Any duergar in sight counts as instant reinforcements against troublemakers.
source_quote: any duergar in sight counted as instant reinforcements
subject: Duergar

fact: Corruption among duergar is very rare.
source_quote: Corruption among them is very rare
subject: Duergar

fact: Duergar are described as grim, austere, and methodical.
source_quote: Duergar are described as grim, austere and methodical
subject: Duergar

fact: If word gets out that the party are escaped slaves, slavers might repossess them or sell them back to the drow.
source_quote: if word got out they were escaped slaves, slavers might try to repossess them or sell them back to the drow
subject: Escaped slave status

fact: Thorin objects to being called slaves, claiming they were merely temporarily detained.
source_quote: Thorin objected that they had merely been "temporarily detained."
subject: Thorin

fact: The party's goals are to resupply with better weapons and armor.
source_quote: Their goals were clear: resupply with better weapons and armor
subject: Party objectives

fact: The party seeks information to find a way out of the Underdark.
source_quote: and find information that might lead them out of the Underdark for good
subject: Escape route

fact: The lost tomb is marked on the dwarf's map and lies on the longer route from Gracklstugh.
source_quote: The longer route ran from Gracklstugh to the lost tomb marked on the dwarf's map
subject: Lost tomb

fact: Blingdenstone is a possible exit point from the Underdark, located after the lost tomb on the longer route.
source_quote: and from there to Blingdenstone, a possible exit point
subject: Blingdenstone

fact: Gracklstugh was a detour to re-equip because the party is low on weapons and gear.
source_quote: Gracklstugh was a detour to re-equip, because the party is low on weapons and gear
subject: Route discussion

fact: The party is currently level 3.
source_quote: The party is level 3
subject: Party level

fact: The party decides to head to the Blade Bazaar to trade and purchase supplies.
source_quote: The party decides to head to the Blade Bazaar to trade and purchase supplies
subject: Destination decision

fact: The Darklake district is fully enclosed by walls.
source_quote: The district is fully enclosed by walls
subject: Darklake district

fact: Staying within the Darklake district ensures safety for the party.
source_quote: So as long as you stay in the district, all will be safe
subject: Darklake district

fact: The GM advises the party not to steal anything to avoid attracting attention.
source_quote: The GM notes they don't want to attract attention: "Don't try to steal anything."
subject: GM warning
